chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this concise theological assertion to affirm the Imam's role in clarifying divine attributes, specifically highlighting that God’s perception is exclusively oriented toward goodness and benefit. This statement underscores the attribute of divine benevolence (al-Lutf) and serves as a foundational proof for the doctrine of divine justice, distinguishing it from arbitrary will.
